coverage_assessment: Open-web first pass: 28 actual English- and French-language searches with 535 captured result headers, including weekly month windows, regional and sector searches, and retrospective leads. Coverage surfaced Buea, Bamenda, Douala, Yaounde and Dschang; this is not a completeness claim. Four leads remain pending because qualifying turnout, date, unit scope or independent February occurrence is unresolved. Local-language and licensed/archive coverage is limited; the official baseline remains pending.
